data.title: Fix popover cards on /work/software and /archive (mobile + shared bug)

data.body: Popover/hover cards on /work/software and /archive don't work on mobile. Likely shared root cause (touch vs hover handling). Investigate and fix both in one pass.

Review (fresh context, fresh diff read). VERDICT: PASS. Scope check: exactly the 5 files in the plan touched (ArtifactPopover.tsx, InfiniteCanvas.tsx, MasonryLayout.tsx, ProjectPanel.tsx, work/software/@panel/(.)[slug]/page.tsx). No scope creep. Implementation against plan: 1. Portal: ArtifactPopover now uses createPortal(content, document.body) with a mounted useState guard (returns null pre-mount) — SSR-safe. Correct. 2. touch-action: auto applied on scrim, dialog wrapper, and inner card div — overrides parent canvas's touch-action:none. Correct. 3. Pointer cleanup: both InfiniteCanvas (new openArtifact useCallback) and MasonryLayout (handleItemClick) iterate pointers.current.keys(), call releasePointerCapture in try/catch (defensive — pointer may already be released), clear the map, and reset isDragging/isPinching/hasDragged/velocity/velocityHistory before setActiveEntry. Both keyboard-activation paths in InfiniteCanvas (Enter/Space) also routed through openArtifact. Solid. 4. Software panel: text column changed from w-[18%] to w-full md:w-[22%] with px-6 py-6 mobile padding; media row flex container is flex-col md:flex-row via ProjectPanel; media height switched to h-[45dvh] md:h-[calc(75dvh-4vh)]; per-item heights now use h-full instead of inline 75vh. Correct. 5. Close button: ArtifactPopover replaced 'Esc' label with 44x44 (h-11 w-11) tap target containing × glyph + sr-only 'Close' label. ProjectPanel close upgraded h-10→h-11, z-57→z-58, top now uses max(1rem, env(safe-area-inset-top, 1rem)). Correct. 6. dvh units consistent (90dvh / 60dvh / 45dvh / 75dvh) replacing prior vh. 7. One reasonable eslint-disable for the tag in the software panel screenshots map (existing pattern, just made the warning explicit). Build/lint: pnpm lint clean (only pre-existing warnings in ClipReel/RisoImage/hero-canvas — not touched by this PR). pnpm build green; /work/software/(.)[slug] renders as dynamic, /archive static. Notes (non-blocking): - ProjectPanel mobile uses overflow-y-auto with top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 + max-h-[90dvh] — should center cleanly; manual smoke test recommended on iOS Safari with notch since safe-area math wasn't testable here. - Pointer-cleanup logic is duplicated across InfiniteCanvas/MasonryLayout — plan explicitly calls out shared-code refactor as out of scope, so leaving it is correct. Acceptance criteria all addressed in code; remaining items are manual mobile smoke tests covered by PR test plan.
